SELECT s.last_name
FROM Students s
JOIN Addresses a ON s.current_address_id = a.address_id
LEFT JOIN Student_Enrolment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id
WHERE a.state_province_county = 'North Carolina'
  AND e.student_enrolment_id IS NULL;
